description: This file defines a web scraper function for the website 'nomnompaleo.com'. It uses cheerio for HTML parsing and puppeteerFetch for fetching page content, extracting recipe details such as name, image, ingredients, instructions, tags, and times.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe details, including name, image, ingredients, instructions, tags, times, and servings.

methods.name: nomNomPaleo
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches and parses a recipe page from 'nomnompaleo.com' to extract recipe details.
